requirements.requirement: Proposal received by 2026-09-30 11:00 ET in one email to Procurement@usac.org and Noor.Jalal@usac.org.
Four separate volumes: Corporate Information, Technical Capability, Past Performance, Price.
Volume page caps are 4/12/5/4, excluding only stated items; over-limit proposals may be technically unacceptable.
Every volume cover includes organization, contact, contact information, UEI, date, 120-day validity statement, and authorized signature.
Proposal includes statement certifying USAC terms were reviewed by general counsel or equivalent legal representative; outside counsel is acceptable.
Signed USAC Confidentiality Agreement accompanies proposal.
Offeror must have active SAM.gov registration for award responsibility determination.
Disclose actual/potential/apparent conflicts including USF stakeholder relationships and provide mitigation where needed.
Describe confidentiality/information-security safeguards; comply with USAC privacy/security controls and approved technology requirements.
requirements.source: RFP E.6.A.3; B.10; C Privacy/Security Addendum

requirements.requirement: Technical approach must explain how requirements will be performed; boilerplate repetition is technically unacceptable.
Provide in-depth proposed AI-use overview and separate with-AI and without-AI Bid Sheets; no AI use in contract performance without prior USAC written approval.
Describe personnel/management capability, partners/subcontractors, rate determination, and firms used.
Name one AI SME plus at least one and at most three additional Key Personnel; max four total.
Named Key Personnel must already be employed by prime, teaming partner, or subcontractor at proposal submission; resumes max two pages each.
Provide 2-3 current/recent similar contracts; each has client/project/period/id/value/reference data and one-page relevance description.
Past performance considered on relevance, quality, and recency within three years of 2026-08-31; references must be reachable for USAC questionnaire.
Comparable commercial work and named teaming-partner/subcontractor past performance may satisfy Volume 3 when performing entity is clear.
Firm-fixed price is fully loaded; all labor, overhead, tax, profit, travel, software/tool/license/subscription costs included.
USAC evaluates price for realism and reasonableness and may down-select primarily on price.

Four-month strategic/assessment engagement: current-state assessment, three-year roadmap, governance/operating model, agentic evaluation, pilot recommendation, executive briefing; no build/deploy/operate.
Pilot recommendation includes business case/value hypothesis, risk, data/compliance dependencies, governance controls, success measures, prerequisites, and high-level implementation plan.
Performance within United States; USAC prefers in-person key meetings but regular weekly office presence is not mandatory per Q&A.
Applicable electronic/information technology services comply with Section 508 standards.
Insurance coverage must meet law/industry norms; buyer has no fixed solicitation minimum; proof required before award and may be supplied with proposal.
Recheck first-party procurement page for notices/amendments before readiness or submission.
